changesets.name: effect-react-warnings-readout.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-react": minor
---

### Added

- `captureReactWarnings` in `client/testing.ts` acquires a scoped, silent capture for story kits. Its `ReactWarnings` handle reads console calls and unexpected caught React errors as a `ReactWarningsReadout`, excludes declared caught errors, and restores `console.error` on scope closure, including failed stories. `expectNoReactWarnings` uses the same capture mechanism.

changesets.name: test-story-proxy-address-hops.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/test-story": minor
---

### Added

- `ForwardingProxyOptions.localAddress` selects the proxy's source socket address and rejects unavailable addresses during acquisition. `ForwardingProxyOptions.forwardedHops` appends visitor and edge hops after the client's `x-forwarded-for` chain instead of the caller address; fixed `headers` still override the generated chain.

changesets.name: work-fleet-idle-priority.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-fleet": minor
---

### Added

- `fleet-priority: low` fills idle execution capacity after prepared normal-or-higher work, without interrupting running low work. Low work still respects held areas and dependencies. Pending low launch retries do not stop normal admission; new provider rejections still pace the scheduler.
